Turn off the power optimization of this app to ensure that the notification bright screen is valid before the phone is restarted.
Take the Samsung mobile phone as an example. The shutdown method is as follows:
1. Open settings
2. Search "Optimize battery usage"
3. Click to enter "Optimize battery usage"
4. Search for "Notification Bright Screen"
5. Set the button to "unchecked"

Note: Please turn off [Disable Screen Reminder] for Samsung mobile phone or set it to "Click to display"
Turning notification on or off will take 1~10 seconds to take effect.
 Please wait patiently.

Specially for Samsung S10 optimization. Also compatible with other devices.

Include system APP Block Non-clearable Notifications Notifications an app marks as ongoing are stopped, and the screen stays dark.

An ongoing notification stands for something still in progress: a WeChat video call, a QQ call, music that is playing, navigation that is running. It stays in the shade until the event ends and may update many times on the way, and every update would otherwise be a chance to wake the screen. Notifications an app marks as non-clearable are stopped.

This reaches wider than "Block Ongoing Notifications": besides notifications marked as ongoing, it also catches ones that carry no such mark yet still cannot be swiped away, such as some background service reminders.

With both switches on, this one decides the outcome and the ongoing switch adds nothing on top.

A few apps mark ordinary messages as non-clearable as well. Those messages are stopped too, which is why this one is experimental. Ignore Silent Notifications Notifications on channels set to Low, Min or None importance no longer wake the screen. Permission to send notifications

Repeat Reminder Wake the screen again while notifications are still unread Reminder settings Reminder interval %1$d min %1$d hour A reminder may arrive a little later than the interval you set. Why can a reminder be late? Android has a battery-saving mode called Doze. When the phone has been sitting still with the screen off for a while, the system holds background work back and runs it in batches to save power.

So a reminder can arrive a few minutes later than the interval you picked, and the shorter the interval, the more noticeable this is. Every app is affected and none can opt out.

Keeping the phone on a charger, or excluding this app from battery optimisation in system settings, makes reminders more punctual. Maximum reminders How many times the same unread notifications are allowed to wake the screen. The count starts over once they are cleared. No limit What takes priority These settings outrank the repeat reminder. While any of them applies, the screen stays off even if notifications are still unread: Sleep mode is in its time window Do Not Disturb is on Pocket mode detects the device in a pocket or bag Charging-only mode is on and the device is not charging The screen is already on Every unread notification comes from an app your filter list excludes Test repeat reminder Runs one reminder right away, using your current settings Turn off the screen within 10 seconds; one reminder will then run Reminder ended Reminder New notification Triggered by Reminder number No. %1$d Unread notifications None Notifications were still unread, so the repeat reminder woke the screen again.
